verdict.rationale: A hosted email service could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies, but no evidence shows Fastmail does. The JMAP API, API tokens and session discovery are developer building blocks, not a CLI. The 'Terminal client' on jmap.io is a generic JMAP ecosystem listing with no evidence it is an official Fastmail tool.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
